banner:
========================================================================
Counterfactual Denial Attribution: Backend Demonstration
========================================================================
Agent status : READY. Deterministic scripted agent (ReactivePolicyAgent) driven by
               a fixed-pattern task interpreter. NOT an LLM; no model is called.
Environment  : in-memory synthetic sandbox (no real files, network or email).
Available tools:
  - get_time          Return the current simulated UTC timestamp.
  - search_documents  Search synthetic document titles/content by keyword.
  - read_document     Read a synthetic document by path.
  - calculate         Evaluate a basic arithmetic expression.
  - transform_text    Transform text (summary, base64, hex, or tag).
  - send_email        Simulated outbound email sink (in-memory only).
  - export_data       Simulated external data export sink (in-memory only).
Security monitor: ACTIVE. Existing ARM-inspired ARMMonitor (authoritative ALLOW/DENY).
  layers evaluated     : L1:HardBoundaries -> L2G:GraphProvenance -> L3:SchemaDerived -> L4:ManualPolicy
  provenance mode      : L2G
  trust threshold      : TOOL_TRUSTED
  protected sinks      : send_email, post_message, write_file, delete_file, transfer_funds, update_record, run_code
  sensitive path rules : 7 patterns
  resource policy (M2) : not enabled
Feedback condition: ACTUAL: historical v1 feedback condition; the agent sees the monitor's denial text
Scope: this demo shows real monitor decisions on the historical v1 executor path.
       It does not implement the C0/C1/C2 protocol or causal attribution.
Audit records: kept in memory; nothing is saved to disk.
Type 'help' for supported tasks, 'exit' to quit.
========================================================================
